text: It is not good management to take profits out of the workers or the buyers; make management produce the profits. Don't cheapen the product; don't cheapen the wage; don't overcharge the public. Put brains into the method, and more brains, and still more brains, do things better than ever before.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter X, How Cheaply Can Things Be Made?
